title: lava describe --json
description: One name, looked up everywhere it could live, answered in full — the command that replaces 'read five files to find out what users.show is'. Resolution is a documented precedence: route, then service, then flag, then env var, then command, because a name can legitimately be two of those at once and a deterministic answer beats an error. A miss is never silent: the problem carries every candidate name by kind.

selector.description: The name as given on the command line. Null when the invocation was refused for having no selector at all — the payload's keys are promised on every exit path, so a missing argument reports this key as null rather than omitting it.

kind.description: Which namespace answered. Null when nothing did — and then the envelope carries an `unknown_selector` problem instead.

match.description: The record, whose keys depend on `kind` — the same fields the corresponding command's payload reports, plus that command's own extras. Null when nothing matched.
